original.statement: Upgrading Crossplane to v2.0.0 requires executing the documented migration steps: adding the Crossplane Helm repository, upgrading via helm upgrade, and verifying the upgrade completion.

decision.reason: [ev-c28095f20093] is the ordinary upgrade procedure: add the Helm repo, run helm upgrade on the crossplane chart, then check the pods. It names no changed subject and no migration step beyond the upgrade itself, and it doesn't say anything fails if a step is skipped. Calling "upgrade to v2" a mandatory migration misreads a how-to as a change and over-claims mandatory work.
